Class GamepadDeviceManager

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages multiple GamepadDevice instances, handling connection state, device claiming, releasing, and tracking last used gamepads.

Methods

ChangedGamepadCount(int)

Changes the number of managed gamepads to the specified value. Disconnects and removes gamepads if the new count is lower, or adds new gamepads if higher. Returns 0 if unchanged, -1 if reduced, 1 if increased.
